description: This file contains C source code implementing functions related to pack objects management in a Git-like version control system. It includes functions for locating objects, hashing, rehashing, packing, and managing object entries within pack data structures.

methods.name: uint32_t locate_object_entry_hash(struct packing_data * pdata,const struct object_id * oid,int * found)
methods.description: Locates the hash index of an object within the packing data, returning index and indicating if found.

methods.name: uint32_t closest_pow2(uint32_t v)
methods.description: Calculates the closest power of two greater than or equal to a given value.

methods.name: void rehash_objects(struct packing_data * pdata)
methods.description: Rehashes objects into a new hash table, used to maintain efficient lookups.

methods.name: struct:object_entry * packlist_find(struct packing_data * pdata,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Finds a specific object in the packing data by object ID.

methods.name: void prepare_in_pack_by_idx(struct packing_data * pdata)
methods.description: Prepares internal mapping to quickly access packs by index.

methods.name: void oe_map_new_pack(struct packing_data * pack)
methods.description: Updates the packing data to include a newly added pack.

methods.name: void prepare_packing_data(struct repository * r,struct packing_data * pdata)
methods.description: Initializes and prepares the packing data structure for a repository.

methods.name: void clear_packing_data(struct packing_data * pdata)
methods.description: Frees and resets the packing data structure's resources.

methods.name: struct:object_entry * packlist_alloc(struct packing_data * pdata,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new object entry within packing data.

methods.name: void oe_set_delta_ext(struct packing_data * pdata,struct object_entry * delta,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Sets up a delta extension for an object entry, marking it as not part of the pack output.

ctags.name: locate_object_entry_hash
ctags.signature: (struct packing_data * pdata,const struct object_id * oid,int * found)

ctags.name: oe_set_delta_ext
ctags.signature: (struct packing_data * pdata,struct object_entry * delta,const struct object_id * oid)
